title: Zakat and Waqf Distribution Operations
thesis: Snowflake turns daily collections and programme disbursements at a fictional Indonesian zakat and waqf management organisation into on-time disbursement and donor-channel KPIs, 7-day delay escalation risk scores, transfer rejection anomalies and grounded AI answers, all on curated dynamic tables.

talking_points: On-time disbursement rate, delay cases, escalations to programme review and the IDR value disbursed by 40 distribution programmes in Jakarta, Surabaya, Bandung, Medan and Makassar.
The programmes cover food assistance, education scholarships, health assistance, disaster relief and economic empowerment. Beneficiary figures are aggregate counts only.
Collections by donor channel show how much arrives through QRIS, e-wallets and bank transfer compared with payroll deduction and collection counters.
Every KPI is a numerator over a denominator in a curated dynamic table, so it can be traced back to programme-day rows.
tabs.call_out: One governed set of distribution KPIs, traceable to source rows

transition.line: Which programmes should the distribution team watch first?

talking_points: Snowflake ML classification scores each programme's probability of an escalated disbursement delay in the next 7 days.
The holdout line shows precision and recall on the most recent labelled days, against the base rate.
Anomaly detection flags bank transfer rejection rate outliers per programme, and the forecast projects organisation-wide delay volume for 14 days.
tabs.call_out: Honest, evaluated ML inside the data platform

talking_points: Field verification compliance, programme file coverage and pending documents frame the control gaps.
Verification compliance against escalated cases by programme shows where missed visits and escalations move together; it is an association, not proof of cause.
The action memo drafts three prioritised actions from the KPI, programme, delay-reason, risk and donor-channel tables only.
tabs.call_out: Grounded draft actions, with a human in the loop

transition.line: What happens when a disbursement is delayed right now?

talking_points: Live disbursement events land in RAW.LIVE_DISBURSEMENTS, from the simulator or from Amazon Data Firehose through Snowpipe.
The Snowflake alert logs delayed disbursements with an SOP hint and the programme's current risk band, then emails the on-call distribution officer.
tabs.call_out: From delayed disbursement to case in one platform

talking_points: The Cortex Agent uses Cortex Analyst over the semantic view for metrics, and Cortex Search over __SOP_COUNT__ synthetic disbursement delay handling SOPs.
Each answer shows the generated SQL and the SOPs it cited. The SOPs are operational only and make no religious or regulatory rulings.

transition.line: Here is how it is built.

talking_points: Two builds share one core: Snowflake only, or AWS + Snowflake (Data Firehose, Bedrock, QuickSight and Amazon Q).
Everything shown is synthetic demo data, rebuilt reproducibly from the repo.
tabs.call_out: One governed core, with an optional AWS edge
